construction_definition: Strict unit-distance graphs on G+uG for every complex unit u, where G is the self-contained ten-point Golomb graph
coordinate_source: Self-contained exact radical table; no external coordinate file

method_context.author: Marijn J. H. Heule
method_context.title: Trimming Graphs Using Clausal Proof Optimization

problem: Hadwiger-Nelson smallest five-chromatic Euclidean unit-distance graph; target at most 508 vertices

related_but_not_used.scope_difference: That result treats M+uM+u^2M for the Moser spindle; this result treats the complete two-factor family G+uG for the Golomb atom with an independent line-circle producer and quadratic-factor verifier.
